purpose: Decide how many reception desks to open per hour so that patients rarely wait long.
intended_use: Staffing what-ifs for one reception with 3 desks, arrival rates from arrivals.csv; advisory, reviewed by the clinic manager.

sensitivity.method: elasticity of mean wait at lam 2.4, mu 1.0

limitations: Not valid above 85% utilisation: 10 replications cannot pin the mean wait within 10% there
Real service times are not exponential (see L200 lesson 7); validate against observed waits before relying on tails
